mainEntity.name: What kind of content is best for AEO for plastic surgeons?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective content for AEO in plastic surgery includes comprehensive guides on procedures, detailed FAQs addressing common patient concerns, clear 'before and after' galleries with descriptive captions, and physician bios emphasizing expertise and unique selling points. The content should be structured using schema markup, be naturally conversational, and provide direct, authoritative answers to potential patient questions. High-quality video content and patient testimonials also perform well, as AI values rich, trustworthy information.
acceptedAnswer.description: Best AEO content for plastic surgeons includes comprehensive guides, FAQs, 'before and after' galleries, and physician bios, all structured for AI understanding.
